epic.title: EPIC-007: Snapshots & Guided Tour
epic.description: L'utilisateur navigue entre les snapshots historiques et découvre le produit via un tour guidé. Story 7.1: Immutable Snapshot Storage. Story 7.2: Snapshot Navigation. Story 7.3: Guided Tour.

stories.title: [Story 7.1] Immutable Snapshot Storage
stories.description: As the system, I want to store each analysis run as an immutable snapshot, So that historical results are preserved and comparable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an analysis execution completes, When results are finalized, Then a new snapshot is created with: executedAt, totalQuestions, successCount, failedCount, configSnapshot (resolved config including real competitor names), the snapshot is immutable (never modified after creation), snapshots are retained for at least 12 months
llm_responses linked to snapshots via snapshotId
configSnapshot JSON stores resolved competitive questions (placeholders replaced)

stories.title: [Story 7.2] Snapshot Navigation
stories.description: As an Editor I want to navigate between analysis snapshots So that I can compare results over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an Editor viewing a report with multiple snapshots, When they use previous/next controls, Then all dashboard data reflects the selected snapshot's results, the current snapshot date is displayed

stories.title: [Story 7.3] Guided Tour
stories.description: As a new user I want a guided tour of the product So that I can understand the key features quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a user accessing the product with a tour URL parameter, When the tour activates, Then it navigates automatically across views (Overview, Actions Center, Category) with contextual tooltips, the user can advance or skip steps, the tour has 8-12 steps total, demo data is used if no real report exists
